item.tib: bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi dbang gi cho ga zab mo lha mi'i gtsug rgyan nor bu dbang gi rgyal po
item.coloph: zhes dag pa drang srong gi rten 'chang ba smon rgyal sprul sku bstan 'dzin phun tshogs ming gis/ rang lo don gcig ste/ kun dga' zhes pa/ shing stag lo/ hor lugs kyi zla ba lnga pa char ldan dus/ snang byed 'khrig khyim du 'byor zhing / 'phel phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa/ dus 'khor dbyangs i/ gsal byed mnga' 'dod yon ro/ spar kha (?)sme ba bdun/ gnyer ma'i gdong can gyi nyin du/ sangs rgyas stong gi dbang gi cho ga zab mo lha mi'i gtsug rgyan nor bu dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ a blo'i ri khrod mthong chen du brtsams grub pa/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi rgyan du gyur cing phyogs kun du bkra shis bde legs 'byung bar gyur cig/
